description.value: You rapidly conjure a small technological stronghold that surrounds you, and all enemies are pushed to the nearest safe empty space outside of the area. The stronghold has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 150 healing Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. It has the tech trait. Several large robotic legs sprout from the stronghold, allowing it to move with you, constantly keeping you at its center. The stronghold automatically opens to allow allies to enter while enemies are kept out. When you move in such a way that enemies would enter the area, they're instead pushed to the nearest safe empty space. Enemies can't enter the stronghold. Allies within the stronghold gain the benefits of standard cover, and all allies who start their turn within the stronghold gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last for the spell's duration.
